channel.title: RNZ Politics Headlines
channel.description: The Latest Politics headlines from RNZ News

item.title: Government seeks urgent advice on how to protect Auckland rockpools
item.description: Whangaparāoa residents claim visitors have stripped local rockpools bare of sealife.

item.title: Mourners gather to remember Sir Tim Shadbolt at funeral
item.description: Sir Tim is being remembered as a man who always chose to see the best in every situation and the person in every person

item.title: First offshore oil and gas exploration permit since ban under official consideration
item.description: Australian firm EnZed Energy's application to explore a large block off the coast of south Taranaki will go to officials with no competing bids.

item.title: New Zealand vacates embassy in Iran as threat of violence escalates
item.description: Human rights groups estimate the death toll has reached over 2500 since protests against the regime began last month, and the US has threatened strikes.

item.title: Skilled migrants on path to residency warned status may change
item.description: Migrants told their jobs were skilled may find that's no longer be the case.

item.title: Health NZ confirms another major tech outage
item.description: A union says crumbling systems put staff and patients at risk, however, Health NZ disagrees.

item.title: Leaders to meet over tourists trashing Blue Spring
item.description: A councillor said tourists were clogging composting toilets with rubbish, throwing coins in the spring and parking dangerously on the roadside.

item.title: Auckland councillors in the dark over government's housing intensification rethink
item.description: The coalition is taking another look at housing intensification plans in Auckland after pushback - but the mayor and councillors know nothing about it.

item.title: Winston Peters off to Kiribati year after being snubbed
item.description: The Foreign Affairs Minister had said the government was rethinking development support after the country's president cancelled a visit here.

item.title: Election 2026: Labour proposes 'game-changing' streaming levy to fund local productions
item.description: The revenue would be reinvested into local productions.

item.title: Conservation Minister says Blue Spring not a priority after councillor seeks funds to protect site
item.description: The minister suggested councils look options they might have at their "fingertips" to generate revenue, such as car parking charges.

item.title: Education ministry failure meant murdered children's disappearance went unnoticed for years
item.description: Yuna and Minu Jo were found in suitcases after being murdered by their mother.

item.title: Ministry of Defence seeks advice for plan to have drones scour Pacific
item.description: The work is attached to its long-range drone project in the ministry's capability plan which has an indicative cost of between $100 million and $300m.

item.title: Manage My Health ignored warning about lax security system - cyber-security expert
item.description: IT experts allege the health portal ignored warnings about vulnerabilities for years - but the regulatory vacuum meant it wasn't required to take action.

item.title: Cyber-security expert launches petition to Parliament calling for harsher penalties for privacy breaches
item.description: It comes in the wake of the major Manage My Health data breach.

item.title: Watch: Ministers mark start of new granny flats rules
item.description: The new rules allow a small dwelling with a simple design of up to 70 square metres to be built without a resource consent, and are in effect from today.
